recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. If multiple parent-account links are needed again in R6, PA/FM should open a new tracker because the current source already reflects the later decision that superseded FHIR-20994's original cardinality request.
issue_request: FHIR-20994 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to change Account.partOf cardinality from 0..1 to 0..* so an account could be part of multiple related parent accounts.
initial_application: The request was not applied as a direct Account.partOf max-cardinality edit. FHIR-20997 explicitly said it would overwrite FHIR-20994 and commit ebc4150af999256bac52f7e2db925c9804a829d9 replaced Account.partOf with Account.relatedAccount 0..* carrying relationship and account children.
additional_context: FHIR-44682 was later Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and resolved that Account.relatedAccount was problematic, splitting supported cases into Account.parent 0..1 and Account.guarantor.account 0..1. Commit 8b7413dafcb1d98ad5db1460c978d1c6295e2a91 applied that change. Current fhir.ini keeps Account active, maps old Account.partOf to Account.parent, and maps R5 Account.relatedAccount to parent or guarantor depending on type. Confluence minutes show PA/FM revisited the relationship model and approved FHIR-44682; Zulip searches found no conflicting seed-specific decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active Account StructureDefinition currently has Account.parent with max 1 and no Account.relatedAccount element, which matches the later R6 decision. Changing Account.parent to 0..* or reintroducing Account.partOf would contradict FHIR-44682.

related_jiras.note: R5 tracker that explicitly overwrote FHIR-20994 by replacing Account.partOf with Account.relatedAccount 0..*.
R6 tracker that replaced Account.relatedAccount with Account.parent 0..1 and Account.guarantor.account.
Separate Account partOf/parent search-parameter issue already represented on the combined branch.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 request to change Account.partOf cardinality from 0..1 to 0..* for multiple related parent accounts.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the seed request, while its later comment says the requirement was superseded by another tracker.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 tracker to represent non-parent Account relationships using Account.relatedAccounts 0..* with relationship and account children.
evidence_items.learned: It explicitly says it overwrites FHIR-20994, explaining why the seed was not applied as a simple partOf cardinality change.

evidence_items.summary: Source commit named FHIR-20997 and FHIR-20994 and replaced Account.partOf with Account.relatedAccount in Account source.
evidence_items.learned: The historical implementation path for FHIR-20994 was the relatedAccount backbone.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 tracker resolving that Account.relatedAccount should become Account.parent 0..1 and Account.guarantor.account 0..1.
evidence_items.learned: This later final decision controls current R6 source and supersedes the broader R5 relatedAccount model.

evidence_items.summary: Implementation commit for FHIR-44682 removed relatedAccount usages and updated Account source toward parent and guarantor.account.
evidence_items.learned: The current one-parent source shape is an intentional later implementation, not an accidental regression of FHIR-20994.

evidence_items.summary: Account is active in the build; R4 Account.partOf maps to Account.parent; R5 Account.relatedAccount maps to parent or guarantor; current Account.parent has max 1.
evidence_items.learned: The active source already reflects the later R6 Account relationship model.

evidence_items.summary: PA minutes revisited FHIR-44682, cited FHIR-20997/FHIR-20994 and migration from partOf to parent-related account, and later minutes record approval of FHIR-44682 7-0-0.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence supports using FHIR-44682 as the current controlling decision.

evidence_items.command: xmllint --noout source/account/structuredefinition-Account.xml source/account/bundle-Account-search-params.xml source/account/codesystem-account-relationship.xml source/account/valueset-account-relationship.xml; rg -n 'account=Account|Account.partOf=@Account.parent|Account.parent=\+copy|Account.relatedAccount=->' source/fhir.ini; rg -n 'Account.parent|Account-parent' source/account; bun run zulip:search fts '"FHIR-20994" Account partOf' --limit 10; bun run zulip:search fts '"FHIR-44682" Account relatedAccount' --limit 10
evidence_items.summary: Account XML parsed, source mappings were present, whitespace check passed, and Zulip searches found no conflicting seed-specific relationship decision.
evidence_items.learned: No verification or community evidence indicates that current Account.parent cardinality needs to change.
